transport: VE.Can — CAN bus running NMEA 2000. Victron proprietary PGNs: 0xEFnn destination-specific single frame, 0xEFFF broadcast single frame, 0x1EFnn / 0x1EFFF fast-packet transport. Priority 7. Payload: 0x66 0x99 (Victron manufacturer code 358 packed with reserved bit and Marine industry group, little-endian on the wire) then regId.L regId.H then data. All fields little-endian. Single frame leaves 4 dat
blocks: Same VREG id space as the VE.Direct HEX dialect. Charger settings §1.11 (0xEDD0-0xEDDF) · DC input settings §1.12 (0xEDB9-0xEDBF) · DC output / load output §1.13 (0xEDA8-0xEDAF) · DC channel §1.14 (0xED6D-0xED8F).

Retailer copy claims VE.Can on the SmartSolar MPPT 150/35. Victron's product-id tables list 150/35 only as 0xA058 / 0xA04B / 0xA078, none of which are in the 0xA1xx VE.Can range. Recorded as an unverified retail claim; the 150/35 appears to be VE.Direct + Bluetooth only.
unmappedReports: 0xEDDE charger number of physical outputs — no MetricKind, and needed to interpret multi-output chargers., 0xEDDA error enumeration extends beyond the VE.Direct list with 24 (charger fan missing) and 25 (charger fan over-current) — no MetricKind for error code at all, and these two values do not appear in the VE.Direct HEX doc., 0xEDD9 relay mode including value 9 'dark/light feedback (solar only)' — no MetricKind., Channel 2 and channel 3 voltage/current/power (0xED6D-0xED7F) — no MetricKind for a second or third DC channel.
